mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meridian_timeslot_summary (id,user_id,summary_date,meridian_slot_code,avg_overall_score,dominant_color_status,sample_count,created_at) VALUES (CAST((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW(3)) * 1000000 + FLOOR(RAND() * 1000000)) AS UNSIGNED),#{userId},#{summaryDate},#{meridianSlotCode},#{avgOverallScore},#{dominantColorStatus},#{sampleCount},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE avg_overall_score=VALUES(avg_overall_score),dominant_color_status=VALUES(dominant_color_status),sample_count=VALUES(sample_count)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id userId,summary_date summaryDate,meridian_slot_code meridianSlotCode,avg_overall_score avgOverallScore,dominant_color_status dominantColorStatus,sample_count sampleCount FROM meridian_timeslot_summary WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND summary_date=#{summaryDate} AND (#{meridianSlotCode} IS NULL OR meridian_slot_code=#{meridianSlotCode}) ORDER BY meridian_slot_code

SELECT a.user_id userId, a.summary_date summaryDate, ROUND(AVG(a.avg_overall_score),2) dailyAvgOverallScore, SUM(a.sample_count) totalSampleCount, ( SELECT b.dominant_color_status FROM meridian_timeslot_summary b WHERE b.user_id = a.user_id AND b.summary_date = a.summary_date GROUP BY b.dominant_color_status ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC, b.dominant_color_status ASC LIMIT 1 ) dominantColorStatus FROM meridian_timeslot_summary a WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND a.summary_date=#{summaryDate} GROUP BY a.user_id, a.summary_date
